profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHelp: This is the email you sign in with; it can't be changed from the app.

budget.title: Budget
budget.help: Applies to the current period and the next ones. Past periods don't change.

gmail.title: Gmail and banks
gmail.neverSynced: Not synced yet · repeats every hour
gmail.connectHint: Connect it so we detect your spending and income from your banks' alerts. We only read those emails.
gmail.reconnectHint: Google cut off access. Connect Gmail again to keep detecting movements.
gmail.confirmDisconnectDescription: We'll stop detecting your spending and income. Your banks and movements stay as they are.

toast.syncRevoked: Google cut off access: connect Gmail again to sync
toast.syncThrottled: You synced a moment ago; wait a minute

errors.invalid_state: The connection expired or isn't valid. Try again.
errors.exchange_failed: We couldn't finish connecting to Google. Try again.
errors.no_refresh_token: Google didn't give us the permissions we need. Try again and accept all of them.
errors.google_unavailable: Google isn't available right now. Try later.
errors.invalid_request: The connection request isn't valid. Try again.
errors.unknown_error: Something went wrong connecting Gmail. Try again.

banks.title: Banks we read
banks.empty: You haven't added any banks yet. Add the ones that email you about your purchases.
banks.name: Bank name
banks.manualNotice: We can't read this bank's emails yet: you'll log its movements by hand.
banks.duplicateSender: That email is already in another of your banks
banks.activeHint: If you pause it, we stop looking for its alerts in Gmail
banks.activeHintManual: We keep its emails for when we can read them
banks.sendersHelp: We look in your Gmail for the alerts coming from these addresses.

notifications.title: Notifications

push.title: Push notifications

state.iosRequiresInstall: Install the app to turn them on

push.help: We notify you even when Prospero is closed. Turn it on in each phone or computer where you want alerts.

fix.iosRequiresInstall: On iPhone and iPad, Safari only allows notifications if you install Prospero: tap Share → "Add to Home Screen" and open the app from that icon.
fix.unsupported: Try another browser, or install the app on your phone.
fix.noServiceWorker: Reload the page and try again.
fix.serverDisabled: Push notifications aren't enabled in Prospero yet.
fix.denied: To turn them on, open the site settings in your browser (the icon next to the address), allow notifications and reload the page.

errors.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
errors.noServiceWorker: Reload the page and try again.
errors.serverDisabled: Push notifications aren't enabled on the server.
errors.permissionDenied: You blocked notifications; allow them in your browser's site settings.
errors.subscribeFailed: We couldn't turn them on for this device.
errors.backendFailed: We couldn't save the subscription. Try again.

notifications.reviewHint: When Gmail detects new spending or income
notifications.needsGmail: Connect Gmail to get this alert
notifications.emailHint: Only if you don't have push on any device, or if push fails

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorDescription: When you sign in we ask for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app, besides your password.
security.disableDescription: Your account will be protected by your password only. To confirm, type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
security.wrongCode: The code isn't right or has expired. Try the one your app shows now.
security.passwordDescription: We'll send {{email}} a link to create a new one. It expires in 60 minutes.
